tools.name: search_remote_jobs
tools.description: Search remote jobs by title, country, seniority, salary, and technology. Requires the subscriber API key in the HTTP Authorization: Bearer header. Consumes the same daily quota as the REST API. Returns jobs and pagination. Does not apply to jobs.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search_remote_jobs" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
